# Import Data

```{r load_data}
myData <- read_sav("myData.sav")

```

## Compute Composite Scores

```{r import}

composite_scores <- list(
  
  PRO = c("PROS_1","PROS_2","PROS_3","PROS_4",
          "PROS_5","PROS_6","PROS_7","PROS_8", 
          "PROS_9","PROS_10","PROS_11","PROS_12",
          "PROS_13","PROS_14", "PROS_15","PROS_16"),
 
  T2_PRO = c("T2_PROS_1","T2_PROS_2","T2_PROS_3","T2_PROS_4",
            "T2_PROS_5","T2_PROS_6","T2_PROS_7","T2_PROS_8", 
            "T2_PROS_9","T2_PROS_10","T2_PROS_11","T2_PROS_12",
            "T2_PROS_13","T2_PROS_14", "T2_PROS_15","T2_PROS_16"),
  
  T_CLO =c("TeacRelat_1","TeacRelat_3","TeacRelat_5","TeacRelat_10",
           "TeacRelat_11","TeacRelat_15","TeacRelat_20","TeacRelat_25"), 
 
  T2_T_CLO = c("T2_TeacRelat_1", "T2_TeacRelat_3", "T2_TeacRelat_5", "T2_TeacRelat_10",
               "T2_TeacRelat_11", "T2_TeacRelat_15", "T2_TeacRelat_20", "T2_TeacRelat_25"),
 
 T2_ASC = c("T2_ASC_1","T2_ASC_2","T2_ASC_3","T2_ASC_4")
 
)

# Composite score calculation ---------------------------------------------

myData$PRO <- rowMeans(myData[, c("PROS_1","PROS_2","PROS_3","PROS_4",
                                  "PROS_5","PROS_6","PROS_7","PROS_8", 
                                  "PROS_9","PROS_10","PROS_11","PROS_12",
                                  "PROS_13","PROS_14", "PROS_15","PROS_16")], na.rm = TRUE)

myData$T2_PRO <- rowMeans(myData[, c("T2_PROS_1","T2_PROS_2","T2_PROS_3","T2_PROS_4",
                                     "T2_PROS_5","T2_PROS_6","T2_PROS_7","T2_PROS_8", 
                                     "T2_PROS_9","T2_PROS_10","T2_PROS_11","T2_PROS_12",
                                     "T2_PROS_13","T2_PROS_14", "T2_PROS_15","T2_PROS_16")], na.rm = TRUE)

myData$T_CLO <- rowMeans(myData[, c("TeacRelat_1","TeacRelat_3","TeacRelat_5","TeacRelat_10",
                                     "TeacRelat_11","TeacRelat_15","TeacRelat_20","TeacRelat_25")], na.rm = TRUE)

myData$T2_T_CLO <- rowMeans(myData[, c("T2_TeacRelat_1","T2_TeacRelat_3","T2_TeacRelat_5","T2_TeacRelat_10",
                                        "T2_TeacRelat_11","T2_TeacRelat_15","T2_TeacRelat_20","T2_TeacRelat_25")], na.rm = TRUE)

myData$T2_ASC <- rowMeans(myData[, c("T2_ASC_1","T2_ASC_2","T2_ASC_3","T2_ASC_4")], na.rm = TRUE)

myData %<>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pro11 = mean(c(PROS_1,PROS_2,PROS_3,PROS_4), na.rm=T),
    pro12 = mean(c(PROS_5,PROS_6,PROS_7,PROS_8), na.rm=T),
    pro13 = mean(c(PROS_9,PROS_10,PROS_11,PROS_12), na.rm=T),
    pro14 = mean(c(PROS_13,PROS_14, PROS_15,PROS_16), na.rm=T),
    
    pro21 = mean(c(T2_PROS_1 ,T2_PROS_2, T2_PROS_3, T2_PROS_4), na.rm=T),
    pro22 = mean(c(T2_PROS_5 ,T2_PROS_6, T2_PROS_7, T2_PROS_8), na.rm=T),
    pro23 = mean(c(T2_PROS_9 ,T2_PROS_10,T2_PROS_11,T2_PROS_12), na.rm=T),
    pro24 = mean(c(T2_PROS_13,T2_PROS_14,T2_PROS_15,T2_PROS_16), na.rm=T),
    
    teac11 = mean(c(TeacRelat_1, TeacRelat_3), na.rm=T),
    teac12 = mean(c(TeacRelat_5, TeacRelat_10), na.rm=T),
    teac13 = mean(c(TeacRelat_11,TeacRelat_15), na.rm=T),
    teac14 = mean(c(TeacRelat_20,TeacRelat_25), na.rm=T),
    
    teac21 = mean(c(T2_TeacRelat_1, T2_TeacRelat_3), na.rm=T),
    teac22 = mean(c(T2_TeacRelat_5, T2_TeacRelat_10), na.rm=T),
    teac23 = mean(c(T2_TeacRelat_11,T2_TeacRelat_15), na.rm=T),
    teac24 = mean(c(T2_TeacRelat_20,T2_TeacRelat_25), na.rm=T)
    
  )  %>% ungroup()



```

## Reliability Analysis

```{r Reliability }

my_alpha <- function(data, items) {
  data %>% 
    select(all_of(items)) %>% 
    psych::alpha() %>% 
    pluck(., "total", "raw_alpha") %>%
    round(., 2) 
    # print()
}

alpha <- map(composite_scores, ~ my_alpha(myData,.))
alpha <- bind_rows(alpha, .id = "Score_Type")
alpha <- as.data.frame(t(alpha))
print(alpha)

extract_omega <- function(data, items)
{
  data %>%
    select(all_of(items)) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    psych::omega(nfactors = 1) %>%
    pluck(., "omega.tot") %>%
    round(., 2)
}

omega <- map(composite_scores, ~ extract_omega(myData,.))
omega <- bind_rows(omega, .id = "Score_Type")
omega <- as.data.frame(t(omega))
print(omega)

```

# Measurement Invariance
## Prosociality
### Configural Model

```{r loninvc}
conf_Pros <- '

# Measurement models
PROSOC_T1 =~ pro11 + pro12 + pro13 + pro14
PROSOC_T2 =~ pro21 + pro22 + pro23 + pro24

# Latent covariances
PROSOC_T1 ~~ PROSOC_T2

# Residual covariances (tra tempi corrispondenti)
pro11 ~~ pro21
pro12 ~~ pro22
pro13 ~~ pro23
pro14 ~~ pro24

# Intercepts
pro11 ~ 1
pro12 ~ 1
pro13 ~ 1
pro14 ~ 1
pro21 ~ 1
pro22 ~ 1
pro23 ~ 1
pro24 ~ 1
'

fit_conf_Pros <- sem(conf_Pros, data = myData_T2, estimator = "MLR", missing = 'FIML')
summary(fit_conf_Pros, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

### Metric Model

```{r loninvm}
metr_Pros <- '
PROSOC_T1 =~ 1*pro11 + l2*pro12 + l3*pro13 + l4*pro14
PROSOC_T2 =~ 1*pro21 + l2*pro22 + l3*pro23 + l4*pro24

PROSOC_T1 ~~ PROSOC_T2

pro11 ~~ pro21
pro12 ~~ pro22
pro13 ~~ pro23
pro14 ~~ pro24

pro11 ~ 1
pro12 ~ 1
pro13 ~ 1
pro14 ~ 1
pro21 ~ 1
pro22 ~ 1
pro23 ~ 1
pro24 ~ 1
'

fit_metr_Pros <- sem(metr_Pros, data = myData_T2, estimator = "MLR", missing = 'FIML')
summary(fit_metr_Pros, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

### Scalar Model


```{r loninvs}
scal_Pros <- '
PROSOC_T1 =~ 1*pro11 + l2*pro12 + l3*pro13 + l4*pro14
PROSOC_T2 =~ 1*pro21 + l2*pro22 + l3*pro23 + l4*pro24

PROSOC_T1 ~~ PROSOC_T2

pro11 ~~ pro21
pro12 ~~ pro22
pro13 ~~ pro23
pro14 ~~ pro24

# Intercepts vincolati
pro11 ~ 0*1
pro12 ~ i2*1
pro13 ~ i3*1
pro14 ~ i4*1

pro21 ~ 0*1
pro22 ~ i2*1
pro23 ~ i3*1
pro24 ~ i4*1

# Latent means
PROSOC_T1 ~ 1
PROSOC_T2 ~ 1
'

fit_scal_Pros <- sem(scal_Pros,data = myData_T2, estimator = "MLR", missing = 'FIML')
summary(fit_scal_Pros, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

### Model Comparisons

```{r Comparisonsl}
lavTestLRT(fit_conf_Pros, fit_metr_Pros)
lavTestLRT(fit_metr_Pros, fit_scal_Pros)
```

# Model ACLPM
## Model 1

```{r model1}
M1 <- '

###################
# STRUCTURAL PART #
###################

# Autoregressive paths (stability over time)
T2_T_CLO ~ T_CLO
T2_PRO ~ PRO

# Cross-lagged paths and outcome
T2_PRO ~ T_CLO        # Teacher closeness at T1 predicts loneliness at T2
T2_T_CLO ~ a*PRO      # Loneliness at T1 predicts teacher closeness at T2 (path a)
T2_ASC ~ PRO + b*T_CLO  # Academic performance predicted by loneliness and teacher closeness (path b)

# Covariances at T1
T_CLO ~~ PRO

# Covariances at T2
T2_T_CLO ~~ T2_PRO + T2_ASC
T2_PRO ~~ T2_ASC

# Indirect effect
IND := a*b   # Indirect effect of PRO on T2_AA through T2_T_CLO
'

M1_fit<- sem(M1,
             data = myData_T2,
             missing = 'FIML',
             estimator = "MLR")

M1_summ <-summary(M1_fit, standardized = T,fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
M1_summ
```

## Model 2

```{r model2}
M2 <- gsub(
  "T2_PRO ~ T_CLO", # old part to be replaced
  "T2_PRO ~ 0*T_CLO",   # new part (fix to be zero the path `c`)
  M1
)
M2_fit<- sem(M2,
             data = myData_T2,
             missing = 'FIML',
             estimator = "MLR")

M2_summ <-summary(M2_fit, standardized = T,fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
M2_summ
```

## Model 3

```{r model3}
M3 <- sub(
  "# Indirect effect",
  paste(
    
    "T2_T_CLO ~ D4_AGE + D5_SEX + SES",
    "T2_PRO ~ D4_AGE + D5_SEX + SES",
    "T2_ASC ~ D4_AGE + D5_SEX + SES",
    "T_CLO ~ D4_AGE + D5_SEX + SES",
    "PRO ~ D4_AGE + D5_SEX + SES",
    "",
    "# Indirect effect",
    sep = "\n"
  ),
  M2
)

M3_fit<- sem(M3,
             data = myData_T2,
             missing = 'FIML',
             estimator = "MLR")

M3_summ <-summary(M3_fit, standardized = T,fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
M3_summ

```



## Nested Model Comparisons

```{r Comparisonsm}
lavTestLRT(M2_fit, M1_fit, method = "satorra.bentler.2001")
```
